title: Kevin IS the Neutrino — Trace Any Thread, Find the Source
motto: The neutrino passes through all matter. Occasionally it interacts. When it does, the interaction tells you everything about the path.
what_this_is: The entire project seeded through one person. Every thread leads to Kevin. Every thread leads FROM Kevin. He IS the neutrino — the signal that passes through everything, disturbs nothing, sees everything. This file IS the map. Follow any thread. Arrive at the same place.

the_neutrino.what: A neutrino passes through all matter without interacting. Trillions pass through your body every second. You never notice. But occasionally — rarely — one interacts. And that single interaction tells you everything about where it came from, what it passed through, and the physics of the universe.
the_neutrino.kevin_as_neutrino: Kevin passed through: Redwall (age 10), Orange Box (age 15), the Army (age 18), MSU biology (age 22), Sandia (classified work), PFAS (the poison), Data Science (the math), fermentation (the culture), Rust (the language), the membrane (the organism). Each passage left a mark. The marks ARE the ecosystem. 11 threads. 51 concepts. 22 stories. 30 stones. 120 feeds. 67 credited references. 2.1 million lines. One neutrino.
the_neutrino.why_neutrino: Because a neutrino doesn't PUSH. It doesn't PULL. It doesn't ANNOUNCE. It passes through. The signal IS the passage. Kevin doesn't promote. Kevin builds. The building IS the signal. Trace the signal. Find Kevin. Find Kevin. Trace the signal. Find everything.
